class Graph {
    private int vNum;
    private int src;
    private int sink;
    private List<Edge>[] adj;
    private int[] p;
    private int[] d;
    private int[] pot; // potentials for Dijkstra

    private static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    public Graph(int vNum, int src, int sink) {
        this.vNum = vNum;
        this.src = src;
        this.sink = sink;
        adj = new List[vNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        p = new int[vNum];
        d = new int[vNum];
        pot = new int[vNum];
    }

    public void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
        adj[from].add(new Edge(to, adj[to].size(), capacity, cost));
        adj[to].add(new Edge(from, adj[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    private boolean findCheapestPath() {
        Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(p, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[vNum];
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        inQueue[src] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && d[u] + e.cost < d[e.to]) {
                    d[e.to] = d[u] + e.cost;
                    p[e.to] = u;
                    if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                        q.add(e.to);
                        inQueue[e.to] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }

    private int[] augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            int prev = p[cur];
            for (Edge e : adj[prev]) {
                if (e.to == cur && e.cap > 0) {
                    flow = Math.min(flow, e.cap);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            int prev = p[cur];
            for (Edge e : adj[prev]) {
                if (e.to == cur && e.cap > 0) {
                    e.cap -= flow;
                    adj[cur].get(e.rev).cap += flow;
                    pathCost += e.cost * flow;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[]{flow, pathCost};
    }

    public int[] getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (findCheapestPath()) {
            int[] result = augmentPath(src, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            flow += result[0];
            totalCost += result[1];
        }
        return new int[]{flow, totalCost};

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputReader in = new InputReader();
        OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out);
        int letters = 'z' - 'a' + 1;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        String s = in.next();
        char[] string = s.toCharArray();
        int[] letCount = new int[letters];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            letCount[string[i] - 'a']++;
        }
        int[] b = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            b[i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        int source = 0;
        int charOffSet = 1;
        int pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters;
        int sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n / 2;
        int sink = sinkOffSet;
        int vNum = sinkOffSet + 1;

        Graph g = new Graph(vNum, source, sink);
        for (int i = 0; i < letters; ++i) {
            g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; ++j) {
                char c1 = string[j];
                char c2 = string[n - j - 1];
                if (c1 == 'a' + i) {
                    if (c1 == c2) {
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -Integer.max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]));
                    } else {
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j]);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (c2 == 'a' + i) {
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1]);
                    } else {
                        g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0);
        }

        int[] ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow();
        System.out.println(-ans[1]);
    }

    public static class OutputWriter {
        private final PrintWriter writer;

        public OutputWriter(OutputStream outputStream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream)));
        }

        public OutputWriter(Writer writer) {
            this.writer = new PrintWriter(writer);
        }

        public void print(Object... objects) {
            for (int i = 0; i < objects.length; i++) {
                if (i != 0) writer.print(' ');
                writer.print(objects[i]);
            }
        }

        public void println(Object... objects) {
            print(objects);
            writer.println();
        }

        public void printf(String format, Object... objects) {
            writer.printf(format, objects);
        }

        public void close() {
            writer.close();
        }

        public void flush() {
            writer.flush();
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public InputReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }
}

class Graph {
    private int vNum;
    private int src;
    private int sink;
    private int[][] res;
    private int[][] cost;
    private int[] p;
    private int[] d;

    public Graph(int vNum, int src, int sink) {
        this.vNum = vNum;
        this.src = src;
        this.sink = sink;
        res = new int[vNum][vNum];
        cost = new int[vNum][vNum];
        d = new int[vNum];
        p = new int[vNum];
    }

    public void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
        res[from][to] += capacity;
        this.cost[from][to] = cost;
        this.cost[to][from] = -cost;
    }

    private boolean findCheapestPath() {
        Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(p, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        boolean[] used = new boolean[vNum];
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; i++) {
            int u = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < vNum; j++) {
                if (!used[j] && (u == -1 || d[j] < d[u])) u = j;
            }
            if (u == -1 || d[u] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
            used[u] = true;
            for (int v = 0; v < vNum; v++) {
                if (res[u][v] > 0 && d[u] + cost[u][v] < d[v]) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + cost[u][v];
                    p[v] = u;
                }
            }
        }
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }

    private int[] augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            flow = Math.min(flow, res[p[cur]][cur]);
        }
        for (; to != from; to = p[to]) {
            res[p[to]][to] -= flow;
            res[to][p[to]] += flow;
            pathCost += cost[p[to]][to] * flow;
        }
        return new int[]{flow, pathCost};
    }

    public int[] getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (findCheapestPath()) {
            int[] result = augmentPath(src, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            flow += result[0];
            totalCost += result[1];
        }
        return new int[]{flow, totalCost};
    }
}
